title: music.queue
description: Append a track to the active device's play queue. Accepts a free-text query (resolved via track search, first match queues) or a spotify uri; uri wins when both are supplied. Denies by name: music_bad_args (neither given), music_no_match, music_no_active_device, music_no_client_id.

query.description: Free-text track search; first match is queued.

uri.description: spotify:<type>:<id> or https://open.spotify.com/<type>/<id>. Takes precedence over query.
